blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday led the nationwide distribution of laptops to public school teachers, beginning with the ceremonial turnover of 209 Apple MacBook Neo units in Dagupan City, Pangasinan. The event, held at Dagupan City National High School, kicked off the distribution under the Department of Education’s (DepEd) Computerization Program. Of the 231,725 laptops awarded, 169,008 were MacBook Neo units and 62,171 were Acer Swift Air 14 laptops. An additional 3,646 MacBook Neo devices were allocated for administrative officers.
